citations.quote: At least two Facebook posts falsely attributed a viral statement to retired Air Force Maj.
Gen. Romeo Poquiz denouncing the leadership of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos claiming they no longer have a mandate to lead.

The graphic contains a photo of Poquiz and this fake quote attributed to him: “Hindi sobra na, kundi sobra sobra na. So, ano na? Liza at BBM, wala na kayong saysay sa Pilipinas para manatili pa. Hindi niyo pagmamay-ari ang Pilipinas. Tama na… (It’s not just too much anymore, it’s way, way too much. So, what now? Liza and BBM, there is no reason for you to stay in power. You do not own the Philippines. Enough is enough…).”
Contrary to what the post is implying, there are no records of Poquiz making this statement.
Posted by two Facebook users, the posts have so far collectively garnered 4,621 reactions, 1,106 comments, and 996 shares.
